title: Semantic Kernel Agents and Planners
description: Implement agents, planners, and tool-calling workflows with Semantic Kernel in C# backends.

blocks.text: Semantic Kernel provides high-level abstractions for agents, planners, and plugins. You can define tools, let the kernel create a plan, and execute multi-step workflows without writing orchestration loops by hand.

blocks.title: Key abstractions
items: **Kernel** — central container for services, plugins, and configuration.
**Plugin** — a collection of related AI functions or native tools.
**Planner** — generates a step-by-step plan from a goal and available plugins.
**Process** — orchestrates steps with control flow, branching, and human approval.

blocks.title: Conceptual planner usage
blocks.content: Simplified sketch of a planner-driven flow.

blocks.title: Inspect plans in development
blocks.text: Print or log generated plans before execution. Plans often reveal bad tool descriptions or missing context before they cause runtime failures.

blocks.title: Build a Planner Agent
blocks.description: Implement a planner agent that answers questions over a simulated order database.
steps: Create an order service with status and discount rules.
Expose it as a Semantic Kernel plugin.
Use a planner to answer complex order-related questions.
Log the generated plan and compare it with your expectations.
blocks.expectedOutcome: You should see a readable plan, correct tool selection, and accurate final answers.
